description: Out-of-scope: `Reply` direction. Charter post-#244 Direction table binds Requestor=replier on Reply comments — for a Reply from the PR author, Requestor=PR-author=branch-author. Under the verdict-only inverted heuristic this would BLOCK (Virtanen == Virtanen), but path-2 narrowing returns None for non-verdict directions and lets the Reply through. Coverage for the second non-verdict Direction row.
command:
gh pr comment 42 --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Requestor: Aino Virtanen
Requestee: Nadia Khoury
RequestOrReplied: Reply

Thanks for the review; rolled out the change.
EOF
)"
